Title: Current Refactor Scope Boundaries
Content: Keep file-backed storage and the single-host MemorySmith.App boundary for this refactor. Search now has lexical, semantic, and hybrid paths, but the durable store remains JSON files and the REST/MCP route contracts should stay stable. Do not add PostgreSQL, queues, gRPC, Redis, or a separate Worker and Dashboard deployment unless a later plan explicitly scopes that work. Preserve API contracts while simplifying internals around the single app service path.
